beat5_takeaway: September is about cadence. The conversion engine works, so the fix is simply putting more in front of it.

goal_narratives: Awareness scored 42%, roughly level with July. Shares and views held inside your Lift range while new followers stayed under the 100 floor.
Engagement scored 18%, down from July. Comments fell from 70 to 18, retention eased to 24% and saves to 32, leaving three of the four engagement metrics under their floors.
